title: ks.cli: command surface and exit codes
outcome: ks run/inject/verify/contain/recover/repro/bench per ADR-07 with contracts Exit codes
acceptance: Every ADR-07 command parses, --help lists it, bad args exit Exit.USAGE
ks run --fault F2+ --seed S and ks inject F2+ --seed S --culprit crm reach the runtime; repro prints NOT A SECURITY RUN
ks verify prints VerifyReport as the last stdout line incl. isolation (test)
summary: Review fixes: CLI builds ks.runtime.RunOptions (no signature introspection); NotImplementedError -> 'not yet implemented'+IO, ValueError -> USAGE. --hold 0 forwarded; run --fault validated via ks.inject.world_fault and needs --scenario world; _world_fault deleted; inject --ticks default 120; inject run_id world-<fault>-s<seed>. Added placeholder-list test. tests/cli 33 pass; make smoke OK. Note: ks.runtime.run lazy wrapper gets shadowed by the submodule after first import, CLI resolves around it (maya may fix).
review:
[maya · changes] Good: 10 commands parse, USAGE=64 on bad args, repro real (banner, DIVERGED), run/verify output byte-unchanged (smoke grep safe), suite green incl. container. Decisions: (a) Signature introspection is out. It silently accepts everything if run() ever grows **kw and breaks on a renamed kwarg. I (maya, ks.runtime owner) add a frozen ks.runtime.RunOptions(fault, culprit, hold, pause_at, step, rogue, slot, decisions, with_baselines) and run(..., options=); run raises NotImplementedError for fields it does not serve yet; CLI builds RunOptions and maps NotImplementedError to the not-yet message. (b) No new exit code during the freeze; IO plus the fixed 'not yet implemented' stderr is accepted as a transient only. Every placeholder must be gone before the finale; add a test listing remaining placeholders so it is visible. Required fixes: (1) --hold 0 is dropped ('if v:'), but H=0 is a bench value; forward when not None. (2) ks run --fault is not validated (F99 reaches runtime; also accepted with --scenario skeleton): validate via ks.inject like inject does, and require --scenario world. (3) Move _world_fault (F2+x -> f2plus_x) into ks.inject so CLI, RunConfig.fault and the scorer share one mapping. (4) inject --ticks default 10 makes t_inject 2..5 and is shorter than QUIET_TICKS; default 120 per ADR-06-metrics. (5) inject default run_id should include the fault so it does not collide with the plain world run dir.

[maya · done] All five fixes verified: --hold 0 forwarded via RunOptions; run --fault F99 and --fault with --scenario skeleton exit 64; world_fault lives in ks.inject.spec; inject --ticks 120; run_id world-<fault>-s<seed>; placeholder test present. tests/cli green. Serial full suite: 715 passed, 1 failed = tests/gateway/test_b341.py (nisha's B3-41 WIP, untracked), not B3-12; test_world_runtime all pass. Shadowing fixed in ks.runtime/__init__.py (ks.runtime.run is now the callable submodule in any import order; tests/runtime/test_runtime_run_export.py). Follow-up for ishaan: delete the isinstance(ModuleType) workaround in _launch and call ks.runtime.run(...) directly.
